Client service · Operations Transformation

Recover transformation by reconnecting activity to operating reality.

For programmes with plenty of work in motion but weak alignment between decisions, ownership, benefits and day-to-day operations.

Problem and symptoms

When the headline measure is not locating the cause.

  • Milestones reported as green while operating outcomes drift
  • Benefits owned by the programme but not by the line
  • ERP or technology change blamed before the process is understood
  • Multi-site teams using different definitions and workarounds
  • Governance forums that report activity without resolving decisions

Business impact

Transformation loses credibility when the plan cannot explain what has changed in operation, who owns the result and how the change will hold after handover.

Scope

  • Operating-model and decision rights
  • Programme recovery and mobilisation
  • Benefits logic and evidence
  • Cross-functional governance
  • Handover, capability and review cadence

Approach

Diagnose the gap between the designed programme and the operating system, then rebuild governance around a smaller set of observable outcomes and accountable decisions.

Evidence boundary

No case metric is used without written clearance for the page, wording and context.

Engagement route

Start with a 30-minute Operational Diagnostic conversation. Fees and delivery duration are agreed only after scope approval.

Frequently asked questions

Before the first conversation.

Can the work start during an existing programme?

Yes, provided the review has access to the programme evidence, operating owners and a clearly defined decision boundary.

Do you replace the programme team?

No. The aim is to clarify evidence, decisions and ownership. Any leadership mandate would be separately defined and approved.

Are durations fixed?

No public duration is stated until scope and delivery capacity are approved.

A focused first conversation

Start with the operating question that is difficult to answer with confidence.

No operational data is needed for the initial conversation.
